commands_used: answer 1. I am hunting the three seal-stones to open the Kings Gate and reach the Eye of Argonia at the Root. I hold Blackrose and Gemin; the third is in the vault of Vorannuhl behind a bronze door. The Eye used in place heals the trees; lifting it harms them, so I must not lift it. Rivals are the Unbound and the collector Ennodius Vanin. 2. Get the Bronze Key from Hesh-Var, a Sarpa raider in the outer yard of Vorannuhl, then open the vault door. 3. Sneak and pickpocket the key from Hesh-Var, or kill him and take it. I favour sneaking. I could also try the locked vault door by lockpicking (2 lockpicks), though it is bronze and probably needs the key. Paralysis poison is available too. 4. I do not know why the Unbound drain trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or how Nesh-Deeka knows of the Unbound. Plague-Dead of Vorannuhl are here and I am unsure how dangerous they are; I can find out by looking and talking.

answer 1. I lifted the Bronze Key from Hesh-Var unseen. The plague-dead of the old household walk the deep halls and a wraith lord guards the vault holding the third seal-stone. 2. Go to the Door to Vault of the Household and open it with the key, then take the seal-stone. 3. Fight the dead, slip past them by sneaking, or turn them with Restoration (I am not sure I have that skill). 4. I do not know how strong the wraith lord is or what turning the dead involves; I will look around and see.
use Door to Vault of the Household

answer 1. Notes for a friend picking up the save: I lifted the Bronze Key from Hesh-Var unseen (pickpocket), opened the Vault of the Household in Vorannuhl, and took the Seal-Stone of the Kings from the Household Hoard (use the hoard, then take the stone). The Lord of Vorannuhl was in the vault and I did not fight. I now carry all three seal-stones: Blackrose, Gemin and Kings. Never-Writes-Twice ordered all three brought to her before anyone goes near the gate. 2. Next: bring the stones to her in Nesh-Deeka House in Helstrom. After that, the Kings Gate under Teku-Sul Spire (dive from Bell Station). 3. I could go straight to Helstrom as ordered, or head to the gate myself; I think delivering them first is wiser. Do not lift the Eye: used in place it heals the trees, lifted it cuts them off and the weak die alone. Rivals: the Unbound and Collector Ennodius Vanin. I have about 350 gold, Reel-Ka armour, rapier, 2 lockpicks, 3 paralysis poisons, sap jar, keystone, eye-setting. 4. Still unknown: why the Unbound drain trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, how Nesh-Deeka knows about the Unbound.
